column1: # HUMAN-TX-ASKS.tsv -- owner tasks where a person's eye or a better image is the cheapest way to move a target (TX-HUMAN-ASKS, 5 Oct 2026, brief .claude/briefs/runs/2026-10-05-acct3-tx-human-asks.md).
# Owner, 5 Oct 2026: "For things with bad transcripts happy to pull down better images, review symbols manually, etc." Every task is <= 20 minutes and never blocking.

# Source of each row: the target's NOTES.md "## Remaining gaps" / Escalation lines, its focus.tsv / sorter/README.md, the ASKS.md row named in `why`, and PROGRESS.tsv for closeness to a counted result.

# Rank = closeness to a counted PROGRESS row (audits done, C not yet) first, then tokens unlocked per owner minute, then whether the owner's choices can be checked afterwards by a control (a period gloss / clear copy / printed key on the same leaf beats a language judge).

# task_type: a zoom screenshots, b sign-sorter session, c short check-these-first list, d single symbol question. Owner picks are a third reader, not ground truth; a worker re-tests them against the named control.

# Excluded: Armstrong, Debosnys and all Birago/Ceppo sorters (already on the owner's board: ASKS 92/98/117/118/122/128); targets whose text is in print (PROGRESS txt=k) with no counted row depending on the read -- fr4715-f61-mayenne-1592 (ASKS 88/89/93 gloss reads), fr16045-pisany-rome-1585, fr16142-noailles-constantinople-1571; found-solved wellington-maitland-1812; machine-first steps where no owner eye is yet needed (vanbeuningen-dewitt-1657 crop pass, harley-287-1587 candidate test, huntington-blathwayt-madrid-1728 849/7-3 eye check, august-van-saksen-1561-64 57 p3 native fetch, malsburg-hessen-1636, decode-1162/1168 native tile cut); zoom-only rows already in ZOOM-ASKS.tsv (pollaky, bullet-tuscany).
